testimonials.name: Sarah Chen
testimonials.text: Alex completely transformed how our leadership team consumes data. The executive dashboards he built are now the centerpiece of every board meeting. His ability to translate vague business questions into precise, insightful reports is unlike anything I've seen in my 15 years.

testimonials.name: Marcus Rivera
testimonials.text: Hiring Alex was one of the best decisions we made. He took full ownership of our analytics stack, mentored junior analysts, and delivered insights that directly shaped our product roadmap. Technically exceptional and an outstanding communicator — a rare combination.

testimonials.name: Priya Nair
testimonials.text: The revenue forecasting model Alex delivered exceeded every expectation. 94% accuracy in a volatile market is no small feat. He took the time to make sure our finance team fully understood and trusted the model before we anchored an $8M budget decision to it.

testimonials.name: James Okafor
testimonials.text: Alex asks the right questions, understands system constraints, and delivers clean, well-documented work. The ETL framework he built is still running flawlessly in production 3 years later — that's the highest compliment you can pay a data engineer.
